title: A licensee may not engage in advertising that is false, deceptive, or misleading
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.03, a licensee may not engage in any advertising that is false, deceptive, or misleading.
exam_relevance: Tests the three descriptions of prohibited advertising in 247 CMR 9.03, joined by or.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: 247 CMR 9.01(9) is a separate paragraph addressed to any fraudulent or deceptive act.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
